target_mapping: Evaluation-only oracle: minimum total per-speaker word edit assignment, one-to-one over all reference and predicted speakers, dummy speakers permitted. Map CHI using this assignment. Report explicitly as oracle mapping, not validated automatic patient identification.
wer: Compute casefolded surface-word Levenshtein rates with fillers/repetitions retained only if reference has no xxx/yyy/www. If placeholders present, ordinary WER is unavailable and token edit rate is descriptive only. Never relabel placeholders as actual words.
downstream: Compare all metrics of frozen latest MiniLM on oracle-mapped MOSS target words with native original CHI/CLAN task reference. Also raw MOSS source segments as an audio-informed baseline, labeled separate context. No model/threshold/normalizer changes based on this pilot.
boundaries: No boundary F1 on mismatched ASR word streams; exact source-word agreement required. Report count/MLUw/SD errors independently of word identity.
statistics: One fixed public sample, no population average, CI, human-level or published-score superiority claim. All missing/unscorable results and errors retained.
